title: probe-terminal-access output
description: Whether sshd on this node accepts the cluster-admin terminal. Deliberately limited to three booleans and the port: the task output is readable by any authenticated user, so the raw sshd configuration must not be exposed.

permit_root_login.description: True when root may authenticate with a password from the cluster VPN, i.e. the effective PermitRootLogin is yes

password_auth.description: True when password authentication is enabled from the cluster VPN

listen_wg0.description: True when sshd listens on the node VPN address, or on every address
